s: elders died in faith (without receiving the promises)
q: These all died in faith, not having received the promises

s: faith is required for God (to be well pleasing to him)
q: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him

s: elders desire heavenly country
q: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one.

s: elders confessed to be strangers and pilgrims on the earth
q: having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

s: heavenly country is a better country
q: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one.

s: elders obtained approval (by faith)
q: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

s: God is rewarder of those who seek him
q: he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

s: God is builder and maker of the city with foundations
q: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

s: God frames the universe (by his word)
q: the universe has been framed by the word of God

s: God is not ashamed to be called god of elders (because they desire a better country)
q: Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

s: God has prepared city (for those who desire a heavenly country)
q: for he has prepared a city for them.

s: Christ is a author and perfecter of faith
q: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith

s: Mount Zion is associated with city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem (readers have come to it)
q: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem

s: mountain (Sinai, that burned with fire) has attribute touchable and burning with fire (accompanied by blackness, darkness, storm)
q: a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

s: mountain (Sinai, that burned with fire) has rule even an animal touching it is stoned
q: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”

s: readers (the audience addressed) has status not yet resisted to blood (in striving against sin)
q: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

s: readers (the audience addressed) has relationship to Mount Zion (have come to it)
q: But you have come to Mount Zion

s: readers (the audience addressed) receives Kingdom that can't be shaken
q: receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken

s: readers (the audience addressed) is surrounded by cloud of witnesses
q: seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses

s: readers (the audience addressed) has come to blood of sprinkling (speaks better than that of Abel)
q: and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

s: discipline yields peaceful fruit of righteousness (afterward, to those trained by it)
q: yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

s: Christ endured cross (for the joy set before him, despising its shame)
q: who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame

s: discipline feels grievous (for the present, not joyous)
q: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous
